name: token-economy
description: Keeps Claude Code sessions lean on input tokens: blocks whole-file Reads over a token budget and shows an outline to aim a slice at, routes the Explore subagent to a cheaper model, injects an exploration policy at session start (and starts grepai watch in grepai projects), and ships the exploring-codebase skill plus the /context-audit, /economy-stats and /economy-help commands.

read_max_tokens.title: Read budget (tokens)
read_max_tokens.description: Whole-file Reads estimated above this many tokens are blocked. Reads with limit of at most 600 lines always pass.

inject_policy.title: Inject exploration policy
inject_policy.description: Add the token-economy exploration policy to the model context at session start.

grepai_autostart.title: Auto-start grepai watch
grepai_autostart.description: Start grepai watch in the background at session start, in projects with .grepai/config.yaml.

explore_model.title: Explore subagent model
explore_model.description: Model for Explore subagents launched without an explicit model: haiku, sonnet, opus or fable; inherit leaves the main session model.
